## CELL FACTS

Cell 土_食神 (Earth carrying The Artisan). Persona The Artisan (食神). Definition line: "Output that flows from you, giving that feels like being". Keyword Flow, charge gentle, poles catalyst Grace / friction Coasting. Family function: Expression. Cost dimension: giving that feels like being; worth tangled with what is made. Arena: craft, hands, the table, warmth of making, fed and feeding. Classical portrait: ease and appetite; output that flows without assertion; generous, content, prone to drift and indulgence. Ruled domains: Expression, Enjoyment, Children. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 伤官.
Element arena: Earth (ground, soil, load, field, bedrock, harvest). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Fire. structural_interaction seed: "Fire generating Earth same-polarity — warmth as natural source of stable deposits".
- k2_overview: "Your Earth moves as the Artisan: ground that sets a table. Nourishment is your native act, the meal made, the household provisioned, the comfort arranged before anyone asked. You produce abundance the way fields do, reliably and without spectacle. People leave your care fed in ways they cannot fully name."
- k2_functional: "You express through provision more than proclamation. The full pantry is your love letter."
- adj_chips: {"catalyst":["Hearty","Settled","Providing"],"friction":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Expression":"Your expression is the kept table: cooking, homemaking, the craft of comfort itself. It looks humble and it is foundational. Whole families run on exactly what you make daily.","Enjoyment":"You enjoy the settled pleasures: harvest meals, familiar comforts, the deep satisfaction of enough. Let abundance be enjoyed, not only stored. A pantry is for feasts as well as winters.","Children":"Children grow sturdy in your keeping: fed on time, held warmly, raised on rhythm. Yours is the house they bring their own children back to. Build it knowing that."}

  - row 0: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 1: [REDACTED: the target row]

- Sibling cell 土_伤官 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Ground-breaking","Deadpan","Unconventional"],"friction":["Contrarian","Eye-rolling","Quake-prone"]}
- Sibling cell 土_伤官 friction row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Disagreeing arrives before your reasons do, and sometimes instead of them. Whatever the group settles on, something in you stands up to unsettle it. Being the counterweight was useful so often that it became a reflex, and now it fires even when the scale was balanced."

Core element Fire, energy element Earth. Law: Fire feeds Earth (火生土: ash becomes soil). Relative to the core the energy is the fed, so Earth is this core's Expression. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Fire core that shows Earth on the friction pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The friction pole of Earth as the Expression is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in); tone by pole: reminder. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 火_土's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.

value.text: Giving is the one thing you never run out of. Since being useful feels more like you than being rested, you keep giving after the supply behind it goes quiet. Keep in mind that the giving lasts only as long as you do.

value_b.text: You give the way you breathe, without checking the supply. You feel safe only while you are needed, and you keep giving rather than stop long enough to notice you are tired. You know the tiredness is a message, and it is addressed to you.

value.text: Giving without stopping is how you avoid asking what you need. Because running low feels better than asking, you give the rest you needed to whoever is next in line. Remember that the rest you keep skipping is the supply the giving runs on.

value.text: Drifting along is comfortable, and comfort is enough for you. Since the easy day never argues and the hard start always does, you would rather drift than start. You will want to remember that drifting feels like rest until it costs you what you wanted.

value_b.text: You drift along because drifting is pleasant. You are never in a hurry, so you would rather let the day carry you than steer it. You know drifting is not the same as resting, and only one of them puts anything back.

value.text: Drifting along is your way around deciding anything. Because the comfortable day is already here, you keep choosing it instead of making the better one. You let the chance you were good enough for close while you drift, and you rarely count it.

value.text: Going soft on the people around you comes to you without thinking. Since comfort is the shape your care takes, you soften their way rather than let them manage it. Remember that a little struggle is also something you can give.

value_b.text: You are too soft on everyone in reach, and you enjoy it. Because comfort feels like proof you are needed, you soften everything rather than hand over the version worth growing into. Bear in mind that ease is only half of what you give.

value.text: Being too soft is how you say you care. Because you put other people's comfort ahead of anything kept for yourself, you go soft over money and spend what you set aside. You know the money and rest you give away do not come back.

value.text: You go soft on whoever is in your care because their struggle hurts. Since you fix their trouble rather than sit through it, you go soft before the first try ends. You keep taking from them a struggle that was theirs to grow on.
